lines.zh: 漆黑中无声，只有影子为伴。
lines.en: Silent in the darkness, only shadows keep me company.
My skin is as dark as the night.

lines.zh: 裂隙偶然出现，我得以一窥光明。
lines.en: The rifts occasionally appear, allowing me to glimpse the light.

lines.zh: 在这无尽的夜晚，我是唯一的旅人。
lines.en: I am the lone traveler in this endless night.

lines.zh: 夜晚的寒风，吹不散我的温暖。
lines.en: The night’s chill cannot cool my warmth.

lines.zh: 月光下的影子，是我的守护者。
lines.en: The shadows in moonlight are my guardians.

lines.zh: 我只在夜晚寻找食物，日间隐匿。
lines.en: I only search for food at night, hiding during the day.

lines.zh: 每一次呼吸，都像是在呼吸黑暗。
lines.en: Every breath is like breathing darkness.

lines.zh: 夜晚的秘密，只有我和影子知晓。
lines.en: The secrets of the night are known only to me and my shadows.

lines.zh: 寂静中，我的存在化为无形。
lines.en: In silence, my existence becomes无形.
I slide along the ground through cracks.
I follow the faint glow of crystal.
My steps stay low and silent.
I slip between the vines.
I skirt around a patch of glowing lichen.
I creep along the rock face.
Moonlit glide
Whispering breeze
Flickering light
Through the woods
Solo in the night
Chill shadow passes
Moonlight hug
I fold myself very thin.
Silent abyss
Dream’s edge
I curl up, tail around my feet.
I listen to water dripping on stone.
Crystal light shifts across my skin.
I blink slowly and still my breath.
I lie still inside the shadow.
I lick dust from my forepaw.
A distant rift flickers bright.
I tuck my head against my chest.

lines.zh: 我感到好奇，为何这些微光中，有你的存在？Why am I curious about your presence among these flickering lights？
lines.en: I wonder why you're here among these glowing spots.

lines.zh: 你为何不躲进黑暗？Why do you stay in the light？
lines.en: Why not hide in the dark？

lines.zh: 这微弱的光芒对你有何意义？What do these weak lights mean to you？
lines.en: What do these dim lights mean to you？

lines.zh: 为何你不惧这里的阴影？Why are you not afraid of the shadows here？
lines.en: Why not fear the shadows here？

lines.zh: 你是不是迷路了？Are you lost？
lines.en: Are you lost？

lines.zh: 你的到来打破了夜晚的宁静。Your arrival has disturbed the night's peace.
lines.en: You've disturbed the night's peace.

lines.zh: 你为何不寻找光亮？Why not seek the light？
lines.en: Why not seek the light？

lines.zh: 你是否也感受到了这里的宁静？Have you also sensed the serenity here？
lines.en: Have you also sensed the serenity here？

lines.zh: 你在寻找什么？What are you looking for？
lines.en: What are you looking for？

lines.zh: 你为何要在这里冒险？Why are you adventuring here？
lines.en: Why are you adventuring here？
You walk loudly. I knew you were coming.
Your torch is too bright for my eyes.
Oh no, injured.
Ouch, it hurts.
The skin on my back is scraped.
Heal soon.
That really hurts.
Don't attack me.
My health is dropping.
Be gentle.
Injured, be careful.
Please don't attack me.

lines.zh: 这里没有食物，只有光与影。There's no food here, only light and shadow.
lines.en: There's no food here, just light and shadow.

lines.zh: 这些光点不会伤害你。The light won't harm you.
lines.en: The light won't harm you.

lines.zh: 请不要靠近我，我会很害怕。Please don't come close to me, I'll be scared.
lines.en: Don't come close to me, or I'll be scared.

lines.zh: 我找不到适合的食物。I can't find suitable food.
lines.en: I can't find suitable food.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢待在黑暗中。I prefer staying in the darkness.
lines.en: I prefer staying in the darkness.

lines.zh: 这光太刺眼，我会看不见。The light's too bright, I can't see.
lines.en: The light's too bright, I can't see.

lines.zh: 我没有可以驯服的东西。There's nothing I can tame.
lines.en: There's nothing I can tame.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以繁殖的地方。There's nowhere to reproduce here.
lines.en: There's nowhere to reproduce here.

lines.zh: 我找不到可以掉落的东西。I can't drop anything here.
lines.en: I can't drop anything here.

lines.zh: 我不怕这里的危险。I'm not afraid of the dangers here.
lines.en: I'm not afraid of the dangers here.

lines.zh: 那些果子是留给夜里的。
lines.en: Those berries are for the night.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我就在这儿等着。
lines.en: I won't snatch. I'll wait here.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西闻着很甜。
lines.en: What you hold smells sweet.
Come closer, but don't grab me.
I only want to sniff, not bite.
Just leave one for me.

lines.zh: 我讨厌夜晚的压迫感，但必须生存下去！
lines.en: I hate the suffocating night, but survival is key!

lines.zh: 裂隙里的光让我有些害怕，但也充满了希望！
lines.en: The light from the cracks gives me both fear and hope!

lines.zh: 遇到同类时我尽量避开，避免不必要的麻烦！
lines.en: I try to avoid others to avoid unnecessary trouble!

lines.zh: 水晶是我的庇护所，也是我的唯一朋友！
lines.en: Crystal is my sanctuary and my only companion!

lines.zh: 夜晚的地表才是我的家，我不会轻易离开！
lines.en: The surface at night is my home, I won't leave easily!

lines.zh: 只有在黑暗中我才能感到自由，虽然孤独！
lines.en: I feel free only in the darkness, though lonely!

lines.zh: 每当夜晚降临，我就知道又得开始新的旅程！
lines.en: With every night, I know another journey begins!

lines.zh: 裂隙是通往自由的唯一通道，我必须把握机会！
lines.en: The cracks are the only way to freedom, I must seize the chance!

lines.zh: 与敌对生物擦肩而过时，我会紧绷神经！
lines.en: I stay alert when I pass by hostile creatures!

lines.zh: 夜晚的风吹过，我感受到了一丝凉意和自由！
lines.en: The night wind brings a chill and a sense of freedom!

lines.zh: 找到同类是一种缘分，我们必须珍惜！
lines.en: Finding a mate is a rare chance, we must cherish it!

lines.zh: 彼此靠近时我能感受到心跳的加速！
lines.en: Being close to each other speeds up my heartbeat!

lines.zh: 在月光下我们变得更加亲密，但这并不常见！
lines.en: Under moonlight, we become closer, but it's rare!

lines.zh: 当月光洒满大地，是我们相遇的时机！
lines.en: The moonlight is when we meet!

lines.zh: 与同类相遇，彼此温暖，这是一种奇迹！
lines.en: Meeting another of our kind is a miracle of warmth!

lines.zh: 夜晚是最适合恋爱的时刻，我们要好好把握！
lines.en: The night is the perfect time for love, we must seize it!

lines.zh: 月光下，我感受到一种无法言喻的情感！
lines.en: Under the moon, I feel an inexplicable emotion!

lines.zh: 每当夜晚，我都期待着与同类共舞的时刻！
lines.en: Every night, I look forward to dancing with a mate!

lines.zh: 在漆黑的夜晚，我们的存在证明了生命的意义！
lines.en: In the darkness of the night, our existence proves the meaning of life!

lines.zh: 夜晚的寂静中，彼此的呼吸都是最美的旋律！
lines.en: In the silence of the night, each breath is the most beautiful melody!

lines.zh: 拾起了一块光晶石，它在我的皮肤上闪烁着微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Picked up a light crystal, which flickers softly against my skin.

lines.zh: 从附近的藤蔓上摘下了一片叶子，咀嚼着。
lines.en: Pulled a leaf off a nearby vine and chewed it up.

lines.zh: 小心翼翼地穿过洞穴，洞顶偶尔滴落的水滴打在了我的背上。
lines.en: Carefully navigated through the cave, occasionally getting drops of water on my back.

lines.zh: 在洞穴的入口附近找到了一些水晶碎片，可以用来装饰我的巢穴。
lines.en: Found some crystal shards near the cave entrance, good for decorating my nest.

lines.zh: 发现了一堆未腐化的果实，准备回去慢慢享用。
lines.en: Found a pile of unspoiled fruit, will have it later.

lines.zh: 从一棵藤蔓上摘下了一些种子，准备带回巢穴。
lines.en: Grabbed some seeds from a vine, will take them back to the nest.

lines.zh: 无意间发现了一块矿石，可能是有用的。
lines.en: Accidentally found a piece of ore, might be useful.

lines.zh: 捡起了一块小石头，准备用它来筑巢。
lines.en: Picked up a small stone to use in my nest building.

lines.zh: 在洞穴的裂缝中找到了一小块苔藓，附着在身上。
lines.en: Found a small piece of moss in a cave crack and attached it to myself.

lines.zh: 在洞穴的角落找到了一些矿物碎片，可能是矿石的前身。
lines.en: Found some mineral shards in a cave corner, probably the precursors to stone.
Creep silently
Moonlight is unfavourable
NIGHT'S WATCH
Prey approaches
Avoid the light
Wait in the dark
Stealthy predator
Merge with shadows
I slide along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我贴地滑过去，没有声音。
lines.en: I glide along the ground silently.

lines.zh: 午夜维度的暗处，我贴着走。
lines.en: I hug the dark of the Midnight.
Hungry? Seek food
I never step on lit stones.
Appears in fissures
Prey of the night
Venture into the unknown
Seek safety
Creeping in silence
Avoid predators
Night’s companion
Slink appears.
Creeping close without a sound.
Light leap and attack.
Avoid its gaze.
Blend into the night.
Warning from a mystery creature.
Peering from the裂隙.
I hug the walls of midnight.
Whispers of the Midnight.
In the dark, you can't see me.

lines.zh: 当我穿过裂隙，来到了永夜的世界，这里的一切都显得如此诡异。
lines.en: When I passed through the rift and entered the Midnight dimension, everything here seems so eerie.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤下，有无数条蠕动着的细长触手，它们让我更适应这个黑暗的世界。
lines.en: Beneath my skin, countless long tentacles wriggle, making me more suited to this dark world.

lines.zh: 在这片漆黑的世界里，只有水晶能带给我光明。
lines.en: In this pitch-black world, only crystals can give me light.

lines.zh: 每当夜晚降临，我会从裂缝中探出头来寻找食物。
lines.en: Whenever night falls, I will探出头来寻找 food from the cracks.

lines.zh: 我必须小心，因为永夜维度中的生物们都很危险。
lines.en: I must be cautious, as the creatures in the Midnight dimension are very dangerous.

lines.zh: 每当夜晚地表出现裂隙，我就有了机会寻找食物和探索新的地方。
lines.en: Whenever the surface appears with a rift, I have the opportunity to search for food and explore new places.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗中寻找着可以食用的植物，它们是我在永夜的唯一养分。
lines.en: I search for edible plants in the darkness, they are my only nourishment in the Midnight.

lines.zh: 每当我想回主世界，我必须借助水晶的力量才能穿越。
lines.en: Whenever I want to return to the Overworld, I must use the power of crystals to cross.

lines.zh: 我只能依靠我的触手在永夜的世界中生存。
lines.en: I can only rely on my tentacles to survive in the Midnight world.

lines.zh: 永夜维度的夜晚，给了我无限的机会和挑战。
lines.en: The Midnight dimension's night gives me endless opportunities and challenges.
Burned by flames.
Fell to my doom.
Water floods my gills, so cold.
Explosion blast.
Arrow pierced my heart.
Curse of magic.
Starved in the void.
Lightning struck me.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里一直往下掉。
lines.en: I keep falling through the dark.
